0022600033.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-6) host the San Antonio Spurs (5-2) in this regular-season Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, with the Kings 14th in the West and 5th in the Pacific, 4.5 games back, and 0-2 at home, while the Spurs are 6th in the West, 1 games back in the Southwest, and riding a five-game winning streak. San Antonio beat Sacramento 130-103 in their last meeting, in San Antonio on October 27, leaving the Kings trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series, and the Kings also lost all three games to the Spurs in the 2025-26 season series. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Daeqwon Plowden (illness), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain).
